proposals.evidence: Platts gives Hindustani wujūd body/person, an Arabic-origin loan. The SSNP Hindko/Gujari transcription uses y for its affricate j, as independently checked against the source, so survey vayūd corresponds to vajūd. The existing Hindi/Urdu donor is a provisional regional contact-language proxy; Punjabi mediation is possible and the edge does not skip to Arabic.
